feeds.title: Klearminds - Counselling, Psychotherapy and Life Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning lead therapy team providing counseling, life coaching, and psychotherapy in London. Helping you achieve positive and lasting change, fast.

feeds.title: Brighton and Hove Psychotherapy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Brighton and Hove Psychotherapy Blog. Brighton and Hove Psychotherapy offer a wide range of short and long term psychotherapy and counselling services in Brighton. Here we will be helping you with friendly advice, tips and stories.

feeds.title: Brighton Therapy Partnership
feeds.description: Counselling and psychotherapy CPD training for Brighton, Hove, and the South East. Topics have included broad issues in psychotherapy such as integrating mindfulness, men's issues, and relationship issues, to more specific topics such as erotic transference and psychic skin theory.

feeds.title: Leone Centre Blog
feeds.description: Founded by Cristina Vrech and Alison Wragg in 2009, Leone Centre now has a number of trusted associate therapists and counsellors across several specialities, varying from individual counselling to corporate coaching. We host Experienced counsellors & therapists, covering Fulham, Putney & Chelsea (and SW London). Let us help with relationship, marriage & couples counselling today.

feeds.title: SeeClear Counselling
feeds.description: Counselling for anxiety and other life problems. Laura offers a friendly and modern approach to counselling in Poole Dorset.

feeds.title: Noel Bell Psychotherapist in London
feeds.description: Counselling and psychotherapy in London and online for addictions, anxiety, relationship issues and depression.

feeds.title: Counsellors Café Magazine
feeds.description: A welcome edition to the therapy magazine rack! The online magazine that brings Counsellors, Psychotherapists and people living with the challenges of mental health together - Counselling Community of like minded people sharing their experiences and views. Promoting Therapy and ending Stigma by reframing Mental Health.

feeds.title: Karin Sieger
feeds.description: Karin Sieger is a psychotherapist and writer based in London, UK. She specialises in supporting people with living in peace, life transitions, anxiety, dying, loss and the emotional impact of life-changing illnesses, esp cancer, for which Karin has been treated herself.

feeds.title: Harley Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Psychotherapy and Counselling in London from Harley Therapy. With a large roster of therapists working across our 4 locations, we seek to raise the emotional wellbeing of individuals and the standard of therapy across the UK and abroad.

feeds.title: Private Therapy Clinic
feeds.description: We offer counselling, psychotherapy and psychiatry services in London, and online therapy worldwide, and treat a very wide range of conditions. Read through our private therapy blog; a selection of articles written by our group of private therapists seeking to help others.
